rows.evidence: Q1: Methodology and Tables 5a/5b - the paper reports results of the project's own on-farm farmer-participatory trials (e.g. 419 farmers for ZT-DSW, 1179 for CT-TPR-ICRM) and baseline/end-of-project village surveys, alongside a synthesis of on-station trials from project sub-reports.
rows.notes: The study contains no drip irrigation, subsurface drip, or automated irrigation treatment. It evaluates laser land leveling, zero/reduced tillage, direct seeding, raised beds, AWD (manual) and leaf colour chart N management under conventional flood/tube-well irrigation in rice-wheat systems. Nothing on ZT-SSD or drip yields. Technology mismatch.

rows.evidence: Q1: Methodology and Tables 5a/5b - own on-farm trial data and socioeconomic surveys from ten sites in four IGP countries.
rows.notes: No tensiometer, soil-matric-potential sensor, or automated irrigation appears anywhere in the study. Water savings reported (Tables 4a-c, 5a; canal lining 30-40% in Pakistan; ZT-DSR 35-40% less irrigation water) are attributed to land leveling, tillage/establishment method, AWD or canal lining, not to sensor-triggered irrigation. No doubling of irrigation water productivity is reported. Technology mismatch.

rows.evidence: Q1: Methodology and Tables 5a/5b - own on-farm trial data and socioeconomic surveys from ten sites in four IGP countries.
rows.notes: No soil-sensor or automated irrigation technology is tested. Yield effects reported concern laser leveling, zero/reduced-till wheat, LCC-based N management and ICRM packages under conventional irrigation; AWD actually showed yield penalties (Table 4a). The study cannot support a claim about sensor-triggered irrigation enhancing yields. Technology mismatch.

notes: The document is a draft project synthesis (ADB-RETA 6208) with incomplete author list and placeholder page numbers; it mixes own on-farm trial and survey data with summaries of project sub-reports. It contains no drip irrigation, no subsurface drip, and no tensiometer/sensor-based automated irrigation; the reviews' citation of it for ZT-SSD and automated sensor irrigation claims appears to be a mis-citation, possibly conflating it with other Ladha-group papers in the [82-84] range.
